⚠ Cross-check with AFM charts. This tool is a digital aid based on AFM Figs 06-08-1/2/3 (Rev 137, Feb 2026), digitized from the chart lines. It reproduces the AFM worked example within 0.2 × 10⁶ ft·lb (A 27.3 vs 27.5, B 31.1 vs 31.2, 9 min). Always verify against the current approved AFM. Not a substitute for the approved AFM.

Cooling times apply to a single landing/takeoff turn-around. For repeated turn-arounds, also fly a 10 minute in-flight cooling period with the gear extended before landing on the second and later turns (§1.B).

Runway data (built in, works offline): OurAirports, which carries FAA runway-end elevations for US fields. Data date 18 Oct 2026. Slope is the average from the two runway-end elevations. Check it against the Chart Supplement when it matters. Weather: api.weather.gov (US stations; needs internet). aviationweather.gov blocks web pages from reading its data, so outside the US, paste a METAR. Wind component uses the steady wind; gusts are not added. Variable wind is treated as a tailwind at the reported speed.
